claims.evidence: Witness photos show a Yamaha-branded electronic keyboard with a large “YAMAHA” logo on the front (Photo 1/2). The exact model/series is not readable, so “professional” level is not verifiable from photos.
Photos show the keyboard and controls, but no power-on/test footage or screen readout confirming functionality (not shown).
No photo shows the power adapter/charger or its matching label/specs (not shown).
No documentation or packaging is shown in the witness report (not shown).
No audio test, demo playback, or key-by-key test is shown (not shown).

risks.risk: Exact Yamaha model/series is unknown; pricing depends heavily on model features (number of keys, voices/styles, speakers, connectivity).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the model name/number label (usually on the back/bottom or near the control panel) and the full front panel text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified Yamaha keyboard with unknown model/specs (worst-case: basic/older unit).

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (keys, buttons, speakers, volume, demo).
risks.proof: Short video: power on + volume up + play a short scale across multiple keys + press several buttons/controls; include a quick audio recording.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults (worst-case: needs servicing).

risks.risk: Power adapter may be missing or may not match the keyboard’s required voltage/plug type.
risks.proof: Photo of the adapter/charger label (voltage/amp) and a shot showing it connected to the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not guaranteed (worst-case: buyer must source a correct adapter).

risks.risk: Physical condition unknown beyond what’s visible; could have hidden damage (stuck keys, cracks, stand issues).
risks.proof: Video pan showing the entire keyboard body, keybed, and stand from multiple angles; close-ups of any seams/edges and the underside.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential cosmetic/structural issues (worst-case: damage to casing/stand).

risks.risk: Connectivity/accessories unknown (headphone jack, USB/MIDI, sustain pedal, mic input). Missing accessories reduce value.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing all ports and any included accessories (sustain pedal, cables, headphone, etc.).
risks.if_unproven: Price as keyboard only (worst-case: no accessories included).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Yamaha model name/number label (back/bottom or near controls).
Video of power-on and a sound test (play across keys + press multiple buttons; include audio).
Photo of the included adapter/charger label and a shot of it connected to the keyboard.
Full-condition video/pan of the keyboard and stand (including underside and any keybed seams).
Photos of all ports and any included accessories (sustain pedal, cables, headphone jack test).
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Yamaha keyboard, but the key factors that determine price in Abuja—exact model/specs and whether it powers on and works—are not verifiable from the photos. Without a power-on/function test and model number, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
